title: Full Stack Engineer - Javascript
description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Why is this role special

As one of the first fullstack engineers, you'll get to significant impact at GlassFlow. As a fullstack engineer, you will design and implement our web applications and collaborate directly with our CTO. You will join a small team solving challenging problems in the field of Data engineering and building a product that will be used by developers across the world.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Fluent in Javascript and frontend frameworks like Next.js and React.
  • Experience with Python and Golang is a plus
  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions)
  • Worked in fast growing environments or early stage startups

Benefits

What you’ll get

  • Real ownership: competitive equity (everyone at GlassFlow is an owner).
  • The chance to build something that changes how the world streams data.
  • The opportunity to build for global tech brands from day one.
  • A career trajectory that will 10x your skills and network.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with Stock Option Grant
  • Ticket for public transportation in Berlin
  • Company c

Tasks

Why is this role special

We are Backend Engineer at GlassFlow, you’ll be shaping the core technology, culture, and trajectory of the company. The code you write will power AI agents for billions of data events around the world.

You’ll be working in a fast, high-ownership environment where speed matters, curiosity is rewarded, and ambition is the norm.

What you’ll do

  • Build and scale high-performance, low-latency systems in Python.
  • Take complete ownership of projects from idea to production.
  • Ship fast, break things, learn, and ship again.
  • Help define the technical culture of GlassFlow.
  • Work directly with the founders to solve problems in a way that no one has solved before.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Deep expertise in Python.
  • Hungry, competitive, and resilient.
  • Someone with impressive achievements that prove you’re a 10x builder.
  • A fast learner who thrives in chaos.

  • Actively looking for startup culture.

Previous experience that could be helpful:

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with K8s, Docker, Docker

title: Software Engineer II - Full Stack - Web Engineering
Software Engineer Linux OS (m/w/d)
description:
Dein Ziel

Als Software Engineer Linux OS bist Du verantwortlich für das Betriebssystem unseres Gateways. Du gestaltest die Grundlage für ein sicheres, stabiles und skalierbares Ökosystem, das den Betrieb, die Überwachung und Aktualisierung unserer Geräteflotte ermöglicht. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unsere Anwendungen und trägst aktiv zur Digitalisierung der Energienetze bei!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und wartest ein sicheres und modulares Linux-Betriebssystem für unsere Gateways.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Frameworks und Schnittstellen zur Überwachung und Aktualisierung der Geräteflotte.
  • Du integrierst Lösungen zur Geräteidentifikation, -authentifizierung und -autorisierung, um höchste Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.
  • Das Thema Linux OS treibst Du aktiv voran und bringst technische Weiterentwicklungen eigenständig von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungsworkflows mit, z. B. Versionskontrolle mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisiertes Testing und Code Reviews.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Linux-Betriebssystemen und Softwarearchitekturen bringst Du mit.
  • Der Umgang mit Tools wie Yocto zur Erstellung und Anpassung von Linux-Distributionen ist dir vertraut.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in aktuellen Programmiersprachen wie C++ und Python
  • Im Bereich Docker und Containerisierung verfügst du über sehr gute Kenntnisse.
  • Mit der Konzeption sicherer Systeme, z. B. durch Threat Modelling
